concerns.text: Phase 6 (Scaling Law Analysis, T025-T029) implements a power-law model and molecular complexity metric. While referenced in plan.md, these elements are NOT present in spec.md (FR-001 to FR-010) or the User Stories. The spec defines success only for linear regression (FR-007) and correlation (FR-005). Tasks T025-T029 have no matching FR/SC/US in the specification, creating unverified scope creep.

Task T010b (Compute physicochemical confounders) is required to support FR-007 (multivariate model with confounders) and US-3. However, T010b is not explicitly tagged with [FR-007] or [US-3], nor is its description clearly linked to the requirement to 'control for confounders' in the spec. The task exists but lacks the explicit traceability tag required to confirm coverage of FR-007's confounder requirement.

Task T016 implements Benjamini-Hochberg FDR correction. While it references FR-006 in the description, the task is marked with status [~] (incomplete/deferred) in the provided text, whereas FR-006 is a mandatory requirement ('System MUST apply...'). A mandatory requirement cannot be covered by a deferred task; this represents a missing implementation for a critical spec requirement.

Task T010b is tagged with [US2] in the text, but the task content (computing confounders for multivariate regression) aligns with User Story 3 (US-3) and FR-007, not US-2 (which focuses on simple correlation). The tag [US2] is likely stale or incorrect, creating a traceability mismatch.
